summary.headline: Wisconsin gas averages $3.96/gal
summary.blurb: Regular gas is averaging $3.96 a gallon across Wisconsin as of September 11, 2026, according to GasBuddy — the highest since June 2. AAA figures put the statewide average 21¢ higher than a week ago, 16¢ higher than a month ago, and $1.06 higher than a year ago. Drivers are finding the lowest metro average in Milwaukee ($3.64) and the highest in Superior ($4.22).
